page.overview:
Who is Edrian Fazir?

is the captain of the Arcane Marshals of the Revolutionary Guard. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Edrian is a potbellied older man with a white chinstrap beard. He is a nice man but does not have the soul of a hero and thus is not inclined to rock the boat..}}

The day after Thjazi Fang's execution, Edrian met Sir Harondus Einfasen who planned to reinforce the Revolutionary Guard by reassigning public resources from other offices by shutting them down, thus becoming Dol-Makjar's "security overseer" and Fazir's new superior. A few days later, he told Azune Nayar that Lord Einfasen had requested the Arcane Marshals to investigate the recent events at the Palazzo Davinos, as it appeared House Royce had reopened the doors to Faerie and kidnapped a large number of their servants and retainers when they passed through them. While Captain Fazir agreed with Azune that morale in the Guard was at an all time low, his only suggestion to combat this was to foster camaraderie by a gathering in the mead hall.

Days later, when Azune was promoted to the rank of captain by Lord Otto Einfasen, the latter mentioned that Captain Fazir's space would be given to the Azune, as his office had already been cleared.
